questions.question: What is the error code for Zuò Pán (Cross-Legged Sitting)?
What are the deduction points for Zuò Pán (Cross-Legged Sitting)?
questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) Neither one of the buttocks is in contact with the floor, 2) Either one of the feet is not in contact with the floor.
choices: Deductions are applied when: 1) Knee/s are bent at the apex of the kick, and 2) Heel of supporting leg is off the floor.
The kicking leg must bend at least 45° before transitioning to completely straight.
